item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00039","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C03","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.78,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02 plausibly supplied a material contrastive template for the child. Both memoranda concern old private claims barred by a statute of limitations, assess whether the claimant had a fair opportunity for judicial review, discuss evidentiary difficulties, and evaluate a jurisdictional enactment waiving the limitations bar. C02 concludes that waiver is justified so the claimant can obtain a decision on the merits; the child applies substantially the same framework but concludes that the Elephant Butte claimants had adequate prior remedies and that stale, fact-intensive claims do not justify waiver. C03 and C15 share similar remedial machinery, but C02 most closely matches the child's limitations-centered judicial analysis.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am aware of no showing, however, that these landowners did not have an adequate opportunity to pursue their legal remedies within the period prescribed by general law or that there were sound reasons for their failure to do so.","parent_excerpt":"The lower court decision, however, was reversed on appeal to the Circuit Court of Appeals on the ground that the statutory period of limitations for filing such a suit had expired.","explanation":"Both focus on whether expiration of the ordinary limitations period unfairly prevented adjudication."},{"child_excerpt":"To say this is not to say that compliance with the statute must be insisted upon in cases where its waiver would avoid a clear inequity. The instant bill, however, is not in this exceptional category.","parent_excerpt":"I believe, therefore, that in fairness to Mrs. McQuilkin she is entitled to a day in court for decision of her claim on its merits, and I would be willing to approve a jurisdictional enactment waiving the bar of any statute of limitations.","explanation":"The child uses the same exception framework and jurisdictional-waiver machinery, while reaching the opposite result on the facts."},{"child_excerpt":"the controversies with which it deals necessarily involve the resolution of questions of fact","parent_excerpt":"The evidence in this case is complex and controversial.","explanation":"Each memorandum evaluates limitations relief in light of the difficulty and contested character of the underlying factual record."}]}
